crossRefs.note: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and…
Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?
The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the…
The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for…
One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on…
Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not…
Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them…

parallels.note: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’ ”
translations.bsb: But the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
